title: Genealogy of the Queen
text: THE following tables exhibit the genealogy of Queen Victoria, through the Anglo-Saxon, the Scottish, and the Norman lines, with occasional reference in the notes to her descent from the ancient independent of Wales. The lineal descent is represented princes princes in columns in regular order; the indirect successions are put within parenthesis, or are exhibited in the form of notes. The dates indicate the year of accession, unless when stated otherwise; and where no date is given, the individual so undistinguished is to be understood as never having occupied the throne.
